data.one_liner: Provides structured metadata for countries, including ISO codes, phone codes, currencies, and flags.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart-only country metadata repository that includes ISO codes, currencies, phone codes, localized names (English, Russian, Arabic), and utilities for rendering flags via emoji or image URLs.
use_when: You need country codes, phone prefixes, or currency metadata in a Dart or Flutter app.
You want to display country flag icons via SVGs, WebPs, JPEGs, or emojis.
avoid_when: You need localizations for a vast number of languages beyond English, Russian, and Arabic.
You need a comprehensive timezone database for every country.
strengths: Built-in flag URL and emoji generation utilities.
weaknesses: Limited to English, Russian, and Arabic localized names out of the box.
Flag images rely on external CDN access.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need comprehensive internationalization, formatting, and locale data built into Dart.
